header: CN 112645853 A　　权　利　要　求　书　　1/2 页

paragraphs.zh: 1.一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，其特征在于，包括步骤如下：
paragraphs.en: 1. A process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, characterised in that it comprises the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: The claims on this page carry no [00NN] paragraph markers; markers here are claim numbers assigned by this pass, with a paragraph index because several printed paragraphs belong to one claim.

paragraphs.zh: (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐；
paragraphs.en: (1) the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt;
paragraphs.notes: 酯解反应 is literally "ester cleavage / esterolysis reaction". 三级醇 is literally "tertiary-grade alcohol", i.e. a tertiary alcohol. 苯甲酸盐 is a benzoate salt; the counter-ion is not stated here.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
paragraphs.en: (2) the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid.
paragraphs.notes: 碱金属醇盐 is an alkali metal alkoxide (literally "alkali metal alcohol salt").

paragraphs.zh: 2.根据权利要求1所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(1)中所述三级醇为叔丁醇、叔戊醇或2-甲基-2-戊醇中的任意一种或至少两种的组合，优选为叔丁醇；
paragraphs.en: 2. The preparation process according to claim 1, characterised in that the tertiary alcohol in step (1) is any one of tert-butanol, tert-amyl alcohol or 2-methyl-2-pentanol, or a combination of at least two of them, preferably tert-butanol;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中相对于1mol的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，所述三级醇溶剂的用量为700～3500mL。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (1), relative to 1 mol of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, the amount of the said tertiary alcohol solvent used is 700 to 3500 mL.

paragraphs.zh: 3.根据权利要求1或2所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(1)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1～1.1)；
paragraphs.en: 3. The preparation process according to claim 1 or 2, characterised in that in step (1) the molar ratio of the said methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate to the basic substance is 1:(1 to 1.1);

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中所述碱性物质为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾、叔丁醇钠、叔丁醇钾、氢化钠、氢化钾、金属钠或金属钾中的任意一种，优选为氢氧化钠；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (1) the said basic substance is any one of sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide, sodium tert-butoxide, potassium tert-butoxide, sodium hydride, potassium hydride, sodium metal or potassium metal, preferably sodium hydroxide;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钠的质量浓度为30～96％；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the mass concentration of the said sodium hydroxide is 30 to 96％;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钾的质量浓度为30～96％。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the mass concentration of the said potassium hydroxide is 30 to 96％.

paragraphs.zh: 4.根据权利要求1-3任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(1)中所述酯解反应的温度为25～40℃；
paragraphs.en: 4. The preparation process according to any one of claims 1-3, characterised in that the temperature of the said ester cleavage reaction in step (1) is 25 to 40℃;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中所述酯解反应的时间为5～12h。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the time of the said ester cleavage reaction in step (1) is 5 to 12 h.

paragraphs.zh: 5.根据权利要求1-4任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(2)中所述醇为2,2,2-三氟乙醇或2-四氢呋喃甲醇；
paragraphs.en: 5. The preparation process according to any one of claims 1-4, characterised in that the said alcohol in step (2) is 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol or 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol;
paragraphs.notes: 2-四氢呋喃甲醇 is translated literally as "2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol". The name as printed is not a well-formed IUPAC name; it is most plausibly tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethanol (tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol), but that reading is not stated on this page and is not asserted here.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2) the molar ratio of the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt to the alcohol is 1:(1.05 to 1.35).

paragraphs.zh: 6.根据权利要求1-5任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(2)中所述碱性物质为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾、叔丁醇钠、叔丁醇钾、氢化钠、氢化钾中的任意一种；
paragraphs.en: 6. The preparation process according to any one of claims 1-5, characterised in that the said basic substance in step (2) is any one of sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide, sodium tert-butoxide, potassium tert-butoxide, sodium hydride or potassium hydride;
paragraphs.notes: The step (2) list omits sodium metal and potassium metal, which claim 3 includes for step (1). Printed as such.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钠的质量浓度为30～96％；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the mass concentration of the said sodium hydroxide is 30 to 96％;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钾的质量浓度为30～96％；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the mass concentration of the said potassium hydroxide is 30 to 96％;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2) the molar ratio of the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt to the basic substance is 1:(1.2 to 1.5).

paragraphs.zh: 7.根据权利要求1-6任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)；
paragraphs.en: 7. The preparation process according to any one of claims 1-6, characterised in that in step (2) the molar ratio of the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt to the alkali metal alkoxide is 1:(1.2 to 1.5);

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述碱金属醇盐为醇和碱金属反应得到；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said alkali metal alkoxide in step (2) is obtained by reacting an alcohol with an alkali metal;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述碱金属为金属钠或金属钾；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said alkali metal is sodium metal or potassium metal;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应时，加料顺序为先将碱性物质与醇加入反应溶剂中，而后加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, when in step (2) the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with the alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, the order of addition is to first add the basic substance and the alcohol into the reaction solvent, and then add the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应时的加料顺序为先将碱金属醇盐放入溶剂中，再加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸
paragraphs.en: Preferably, when in step (2) the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with the alkali metal alkoxide, the order of addition is to first put the alkali metal alkoxide into the solvent, and then add the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzo[
